title: Meet MindFoundry: Your Child's AI Math Tutor

voiceover.text: Every night, millions of parents watch their child struggle with math. The tears. The frustration. The feeling that you can't help.

visuals.description: Warm-lit living room scene. A parent and child (around age 8) sit at a kitchen table with scattered homework papers. The child looks down at a math worksheet with a pencil in hand, expression showing confusion. Soft, cinematic lighting.
visuals.animation: Slow zoom in on the scene. Subtle vignette effect.

voiceover.text: Private tutoring costs fifty to a hundred and fifty dollars an hour. And even then — it's one size fits all. Your child deserves better than that.

visuals.description: Split screen: Left side shows a calculator with dollar amounts ticking up ($50, $75, $100, $150/hr). Right side shows a clock spinning fast. Background gradient from dark to warm. Text: '$50-$150/hr' appears large, then 'One Size Fits All' fades in below.
visuals.animation: Counter animation for dollar amounts. Clock spinning. Text fade-in.

voiceover.text: You can see the grade on the report card. But you can't see what they don't understand. Until now.

visuals.description: Close-up of a child's hand erasing an answer on a worksheet, eraser shavings visible. Camera pulls back slightly to reveal crumpled paper nearby. Then a subtle glow begins from the edge of frame.
visuals.animation: Slow pan. Text 'Until now.' fades in with teal glow at the end.

voiceover.text: Meet MindFoundry. Your child's personal AI math tutor.

visuals.description: Dark screen. The MindFoundry logo fades in center screen with a warm orange-to-teal gradient burst behind it. Particles float upward. The tagline 'Your Child's AI Math Tutor' appears below.
visuals.animation: Logo scale from 0 to 1 with spring physics. Gradient burst. Particle system. Tagline slides up.

voiceover.text: Built on the Kumon method — proven across fifty countries and four million students — combined with an AI that teaches thinking, not just answers.

visuals.description: World map with glowing dots in 50+ countries. Counter animates: '50 Countries' and '4M+ Students'. Then a split visual: left shows traditional Kumon worksheet, right shows the MindFoundry app interface, connected by a glowing bridge.
visuals.animation: Map dots light up progressively. Counters animate. Split screen merge animation.

voiceover.text: Watch your child solve problems at their own pace. When they get stuck, Ms. Guide steps in — not with the answer, but with a hint that builds understanding.

visuals.description: App study page showing a multi-problem worksheet view. Child taps a number on the number pad. A green checkmark appears for a correct answer. Then on the next problem, the child gets it wrong — Ms. Guide character appears with a speech bubble showing a micro hint. The hint is a gentle question, not the answer.
visuals.animation: Simulated app interaction. Number pad tap animation. Checkmark animation. Ms. Guide slide-in from right with speech bubble.

voiceover.text: Every win gets celebrated. From their very first problem solved, to a hundred-day streak.

visuals.description: App celebration screen. Confetti particles explode from center. A large achievement card shows '100-Day Streak!' with the child's avatar emoji, a gold badge, and a 'Share' button. The card has teal borders and gold corners.
visuals.animation: Confetti particle system (200 particles). Achievement card scales in with spring bounce. Badge glow pulse.

voiceover.text: And you? You see everything. Accuracy trends. Time spent. Which concepts need work. You'll know exactly where your child stands.

visuals.description: Parent dashboard view. Animated charts showing accuracy trends going up over time. A daily practice bar chart. A performance quadrant scatter plot. Key metrics highlighted: '94% Accuracy', '23 Day Streak', 'Level 3A → 2A Progress'.
visuals.animation: Charts draw in progressively. Numbers count up. Metrics highlight with teal glow.

voiceover.text: Stuck on homework? Snap a photo. MindFoundry extracts every problem and Ms. Guide explains each one, step by step.

visuals.description: Homework Helper flow: Phone camera viewfinder pointing at a math worksheet. A capture button is tapped. Loading spinner. Then extracted problems appear in a clean list with checkboxes. Ms. Guide explains the selected problem with step-by-step breakdown.
visuals.animation: Camera shutter animation. Problems slide in from bottom. Explanation text types out.

voiceover.text: Plus hundreds of instructional videos that unlock as they progress through each level.

visuals.description: Video library view showing category cards: 'Counting', 'Adding', 'Fractions', etc. Some cards have a lock icon, others show 'Unlocked!' with a checkmark. A recommended videos carousel scrolls at the top. One card glows as it transitions from locked to unlocked.
visuals.animation: Cards cascade in. Lock icon transforms to checkmark with particle effect. Carousel auto-scrolls.

voiceover.text: Twenty-six mastery levels. Over five thousand worksheets. More than fifty thousand problems. From counting to calculus — all in one app.
voiceover.pace: rhythmic, each number lands with weight

visuals.description: Dark background. Three animated counters appear in sequence: '26 Levels' (with level badges cascading), '5,200 Worksheets' (with stacking paper animation), '52,000+ Problems' (with number matrix effect). Then a gradient bar showing the progression from '7A: Counting' to 'O: Calculus' with all levels marked.
visuals.animation: Counters spin up rapidly. Level badges cascade. Progress bar fills left to right with gradient.

voiceover.text: One account for the whole family. Add your children, track each one separately, and save with progressive discounts — up to fifty percent off.

visuals.description: Happy family scene: parent with two children (ages ~6 and ~9) sitting on a couch, each child holding a tablet. The parent looks at their phone showing the parent dashboard. Warm lighting, cozy home environment. Overlay text shows pricing: '1 child: Full price', '2 children: 20% off', '3+: Up to 50% off'.
visuals.animation: Pricing tiers slide in from right. Discount percentages highlight in teal.

voiceover.text: Start your free sixty-day trial today. No credit card required. Give your child the math confidence they deserve.

visuals.description: Clean dark background with MindFoundry logo centered. Below: a large glowing CTA button reading 'Start Free Trial'. Below that: '60 Days Free • No Credit Card'. The URL 'mindfoundry.app' appears at bottom. Subtle teal-to-orange gradient particles float in background. Brand colors pulse gently.
visuals.animation: Logo fade in. CTA button pulse with glow. URL slide up. Particle system continues. Gentle fade to black at end.

music.notes: Music should swell during solution-intro and cta scenes. Quieter during problem scenes.
